title: Counting Bits
prompt:
Given `n`, return an array `ans` of length `n+1` where `ans[i]` is the number of 1-bits in `i`.

**Example**: `n = 5` → `[0,1,1,2,1,2]`.

DP on bits: `bits[i] = bits[i >> 1] + (i & 1)` — i has the same bits as i/2 plus its own lowest bit.
hints: Dropping i's lowest bit gives i >> 1, whose bit count you already computed.
Fill the array left to right from bits[0] = 0.

solution.explanation: `i >> 1` is i with its lowest bit removed, so it has exactly one fewer bit than i when i is odd, and the same count when i is even — captured by adding `i & 1`. Since i >> 1 < i, its answer is already known: O(n) total instead of O(n log n).
